text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"@'
# Issue #63 — Independent proactive visual QA

Issue: [Prove the complete frontend journey with no backend and honest media evidence](https://github.com/dystrophyless/dubbed.ai/issues/63)  
Reviewer: **GPT-6.1 Sol, High reasoning**, dedicated to #63 only.  
Review date: **2026-10-25, Asia/Qyzylorda** (capture timestamps use UTC).  
Verdict: **The sampled native mock journey works; the closed gate does not establish the full claimed visual acceptance.** Findings: **1 HIGH, 2 MEDIUM, 0 LOW**. This review neither changes acceptance records nor reopens the issue.

## Scope and provenance

#63 is a verification gate, with no standalone product screen. Its user job is to establish that a person can enter, prepare a scene, record and accept all lines, receive the intended result and download it, while making simulated effects and missing evidence explicit. I reviewed the visible consequences of that gate through one native integrated journey and audited its acceptance evidence. I did not take over the producer issues.

- Baseline and final checked HEAD: `9d286621177200fdb5f61ef963d0b6818ae76774`.
- `git diff --name-only -- frontend` was empty. Existing dirty documentation, skills, evidence and other reviewers' files were preserved. All writes from this reviewer are inside this `issue-63/` directory.
- Issue contract: [fresh read-only issue snapshot](../contracts/issue-63.md), captured by the coordinator on 2026-10-25, closed with zero discussion comments. See lines 21, 89–100 for acceptance and visual requirements.
- Browser: installed Chromium **156.0.8078.4**, Playwright from the existing frontend installation; headless Windows, DPR 1, CSS viewport sizes recorded per capture, ordinary 100% page scale. Vite mock server isolated at `127.0.0.1:4363`; the disposable script retained and killed only its own server process. The process was absent after completion.
- All audio output muted; fake-device and fake-permission-UI browser flags. No physical microphone, speakers, backend, provider, payment or production storage was exercised.
- No service/IndexedDB seeding or fixture-state harness. Registration, source selection, quote, microphone permission, all three captures, acceptance and download used product UI. The uploaded file and output remain conspicuously synthetic fixtures.
- Captures wait for `document.fonts.ready`. Both Mabry Pro 400 and 500 report `loaded`; measured action labels use `"Mabry Pro", sans-serif`, weight 500. Timing-sensitive media/loading screenshots are marked below rather than treated as settled playback evidence.

Fresh artifacts: [capture script](capture.cjs), [capture log](capture.log), [raw geometry and download metrics](metrics.json), [screenshot manifest](screenshot-manifest.json), [reviewed source hashes](source-hashes.json). Seventeen fresh PNGs were opened with `view_image`, including every image used below. The selected reference PNGs were separately opened; their large raster display size was not interpreted as CSS geometry.

## Executed journey and what works

The final command was `node _docs/evidence/proactive-visual-qa-2026-10-25/issue-63/capture.cjs` from the repository root. It completed without a page error or an observed request outside the local Vite origin/blob/data URLs. This is a sampled frontend transport observation, not a general network/security audit.

1. Changed the visible locale to EN, entered registration from the landing action, entered a disposable `@example.test` identity, read the explicitly simulated code notice and completed the code UI. No email-delivery claim is made.
2. Uploaded `frontend/public/media/source-dialogue.mp4`, validated and saved it, obtained the 9-credit quote for the unchanged 8.625-second default section and authorized processing. The displayed balance became 111 after the initial 120-credit grant. This review did not re-prove all interval/ledger boundary cases.
3. Entered the real browser microphone API path with a synthetic input, explicitly allowed the microphone and continued to Record. Captured desktop, short desktop, RU phone and the 767/768 boundary with the same native project.
4. Captured an actual synthetic-device take, inspected the candidate and leave guard, chose Stay here, accepted all three lines through Next line, and reached generation 1 automatically.
5. Inspected EN desktop/short and RU phone Result. Requested the download through the RU button. Downloaded `source-dialogue.mp4`: **211,221 bytes**, SHA-256 `af77d8889ab4675a7b70f28955930ee7cf094f2c9f07452b60da26522ddf87a2`, exactly matching bundled `result-generation-001.mp4`. This proves delivered fixture identity, not synthesis from these captures.

The quiet light shell, retained Mabry, readable 16px dialogue, localized phone actions, visible mock notices, explicit candidate-versus-accepted distinction and automatic final acceptance handoff all support the intended journey. In the 390px RU Record sample, target text and waveform fit above the fixed panel, and measured record/navigation actions are at least 48px tall. The 768px sample uses ordinary document-flow controls as required. No page-wide horizontal overflow was measured in the sampled states.

## Expected versus observed

| Criterion / state | Expected | Fresh observation / evidence | Review status |
